_desc: Footer: 'Navigate' column (page links), 'Connect' column (auto-filled from socials.json), and the copyright line.

_fields.navigateOverride: Leave [] to auto-generate from enabled sections (Home, Work, Blog, Resume, Projects, Gears, Setup, Terminal, Books, Movies, RSS — only the enabled ones). Or supply [{label, href}] to control it manually.
_fields.copyrightName: Name in '© {year} {name}. All rights reserved.' "" = defaults to profile.json fullName.
_fields.extraLinks: Anything extra that isn't a page or social: [{label, href}].
